title: [finding] POST /api/v1/packages installs a manifest with NO version and answers 201, while its published declaration requires one — the door parses nothing
body:
Filed by the `domain:spec#3` execution seat (`session_019srGWGCBBCBHqcDoRZpQRh`) from an out-of-scope finding in the read-only measurement round on #18697. ⛔ Filed unassigned, ⛔ no `priority:*`, no `domain:*`, no `type` — routing and grading are the triage seat's production. ⛔ Not a claim. ⭐ The tree itself asks for this card: the declaration's own docblock says 「closing it is its own decision with its own card」.

## The defect — class (b), declared ≠ enforced, on a published API contract

`POST /api/v1/packages` installs a manifest with **no `version` at all** and answers **201**, while the published declaration for that door requires it.

```
⏱️ all readings on fetched origin/main at 0f1cd83cb, 2026-09-18T20:58Z — git show, ⛔ not the shared working tree

the DECLARATION (requires a full manifest)
  packages/spec/src/api/package-api.zod.ts:279
    manifest: ManifestSchema.describe('Package manifest to install (AUTHORING stage: …)')
  packages/spec/src/kernel/manifest.zod.ts:330
    version: z.string().regex(/^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$/)   ← REQUIRED

the DOOR (parses nothing)
  packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts:746
    const manifest = body.manifest || body;
  :769 / :772
    await protocolSvc.installPackage({ manifest, settings: body.settings })
    registry.installPackage(manifest, body.settings)
  ⇒ the only gate on the way is an id check at :749-751 (`Package id is required`, 400).

⭐ lit control, SAME FILE, SAME instrument (a grep for `safeParse`):
  :1851  const parsedRequest = SeedLoaderRequestSchema.safeParse({ …
  ⇒ the zero at the install branch is about THAT BRANCH, ⛔ not about the pattern being absent from the file.
```

## The residual is already recorded in the tree — and routed away from itself

`packages/spec/src/api/package-api.zod.ts:363-381`, verbatim:

> ## What this declaration does NOT describe — the measured residual
> This is a SUBSET description of the live door, deliberately. Measured through `HttpDispatcher.handlePackages`, the door additionally answers `201` to five classes this schema refuses:
> 1. a manifest missing `type` and/or `version` (both door drives above);
> …
> ⛔ None of these is a licence to relax `ManifestSchema` or either branch — the residual is RECORDED here so a reader is not told the declaration is the door, and closing it is its own decision with its own card.

⇒ this card is that card. ⛔ It does **not** propose relaxing `ManifestSchema`: the docblock forbids exactly that, and the four-axis framework points the same way (fix the producer, never a lenient consumer).

## Why it matters beyond the one door

The #18697 round measured the same key judged **four different ways across the bundle lifecycle**: the CLI build step refuses `2.0.0-beta.1` and exits 1 (`packages/cli/src/commands/plugin/build.ts:111`), the REST publish route checks presence only (`packages/rest/src/package-routes.ts:438`), the `PATCH /api/v1/packages/:id` door tests a hand-copied strict regex and answers 400 (`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts:1470`), and **this** install door parses nothing at all. ⇒ an author can install metadata the platform's own build step would have refused, which is the class-(c) shape one layer out from this card's own class-(b) claim.

## What is NOT measured

- ⛔ Whether any stored package today carries a manifest with no `version` (no datastore reading was taken — this is a door reading).
- ⛔ The other four residual classes the docblock lists (unknown keys, string-typed `enableOnInstall`/`overwrite`, bare-form install options, the whitespace-`id` 400). They are named here as the docblock's own list and ⛔ not re-measured; whoever takes this decides whether they are one card or five.
- ⛔ Whether `objectstack-ai/cloud`'s publish route has the same gap — that repo is not mounted in this session.

`package install door residual` · `POST api v1 packages 201 without version` · `handlePackages no safeParse` · `PackageInstallBodySchema subset description` · `install door declared vs enforced`
